description: Root public keys compiled into Hive (hive_wire::roots) and the 3.12.0 engine (SPEC-SECURITY-OPS 5.6 step 2, RESOLUTIONS R55). public_key is standard base64 of the 32-byte Ed25519 key. Hosted and retired roots use the C0 key_id hex(blake3(pk))[..16]; vendor roots use the root certificate issuer_key_id key:ed25519-hex(sha256(pk))[..32]. hosted holds the root hive.leanctx.com uses today, so 3.12.0 engines keep connecting; pre_rotation names that root while the offline rotation V15.O9 is open, and root-cert status refuses government workspaces (roots_not_rotated) while it is the only hosted root that signs the key set. The 3.12.0 release gate refuses an empty hosted list.
